title: Adapting Safe-for-Work Classifier for Malaysian Language Text: Enhancing Alignment in LLM-Ops Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Curating a Malaysian language dataset and training a classifier using LLM knowledge distillation (zero-shot prompting), centroid-based filtering, and active learning to identify sexist text that promotes discrimination, prejudice, or stereotyping based on sex/gender.

Curating a Malaysian language dataset and training a classifier using LLM knowledge distillation (zero-shot prompting), centroid-based filtering, and active learning to identify racist text that discriminates, antagonizes, or promotes hatred based on race, ethnicity, or nationality.

Curating a Malaysian language dataset and training a classifier using LLM knowledge distillation, centroid-based filtering, and active learning to identify text that disrespects, mocks, or insults individuals based on religious beliefs, practices, or figures.

Curating a Malaysian language dataset and training a classifier using LLM knowledge distillation (zero-shot prompting), centroid-based filtering, and active learning to identify text that stigmatizes, mocks, or discriminates against individuals with psychiatric or mental health conditions.
